name: default-mix
about: Which resampling kernel each of the phone's paths uses (gen/phone.py). No phone has been measured yet (the lab's probe page is deferred: it needs the owner's phones), so each op draws from a mix and its name (phone.profile_id) is written beside what it made. The heaviest kernel of each mix is the one the exams use. A measured profile comes from `python -m gen profile --from probe.json`. Chromium (desktop, headless) is measured on every PR by tests/e2e/phone-parity.test.js: createImageBitmap 'low' and drawImage at the default smoothing are 'bilinear', imageSmoothingQuality 'high' is 'high'. Safari is not measured.
